diagnosis: On a touchscreen the last InputEventScreenTouch is the tap on the on-screen CAST button (drax's web overlay, bottom of the screen), so vfx_cursor_override = the button's world position = behind/below the follow-camera-centred Keeper; the cast resolves toward it. Mouse users never hit this because mouse events clear the override.
